newsitem.title: FRANCE: French insurers Axa, UAP announce alliance plans.
newsitem.headline: French insurers Axa, UAP announce alliance plans.

text.p: French insurers Axa and UAP are to reveal plans on Tuesday for an alliance that could create the world's largest insurance company, a UAP spokesman said.
The insurers' boards are due to meet during the morning and have requested the suspension of their shares on the Paris bourse, the spokesman said.
A statement on the deal is due to be released during the morning.
French newspapers said a UAP-Axa alliance would create the world's biggest insurance company.
Talk of an Axa takeover has been pushing UAP shares up on the Paris stock exchange recently.
